Pie Charts

Pie charts are rendered as inline SVG. Define slices as Label = value pairs.

Syntax

::: pie
title = Chart Title
Slice A = 40
Slice B = 30
Slice C = 20
Slice D = 10
:::

Example: Resource Distribution

Resource Distribution
Coal (35%)Iron (25%)Copper (20%)Stone (15%)Sand (5%)
